documents.name: Dana International Background
documents.source: Dana International is an iconic Israeli singer who made history by winning the Eurovision Song Contest in 1998 with her song 'Diva'. She is one of the most famous transgender entertainers in the world and a symbol of courage, identity, and artistic excellence. Born in Tel Aviv, Dana rose through the Israeli music scene in the early 1990s with dance and pop hits. Her Eurovision victory was a landmark moment not just for Israel but for LGBTQ+ rights globally. She has released numerous albums throughout her career spanning decades. Dana is known for her theatrical performances, glamorous style, and powerhouse vocals. She returned to Eurovision in 2011, again representing Israel. She is a beloved cultural icon in Israel and has a significant international following particularly in Europe. Dana uses her platform to advocate for transgender rights and visibility. She has received numerous awards and honors for her contributions to music and equality. Her song 'Diva' remains one of the most recognized Eurovision entries of all time.
